_comment: One-off re-read requests for the sec-facts cron: a symbol whose stored set was last verified BEFORE requestedAt is put on the manifest's reverify queue (reason 'requested'), at most SEC_REREAD_REQUESTS_PER_RUN (12) a run. The cron's own verifiedAt stamp retires the request once the re-read lands, so an entry left here is inert. Read by lib/server/secRereadRequests.ts. No secret, no manual call: a code change, reviewed like any other.

requests.reason: #581: predecessor-CIK merge (holding-company succession); the stored set predates it and is not stale by the window/chain/label rules
fiscal-year anchor fix: a duration ending after its own filing date is no longer the filing's period; the stored set has 0 years and a June quarter labelled Q1

#552 COWORK #31: cover count now read per class from the filing's own instance, weighted by data/sec/share-classes.json; the stored set carries the old missing/stale companyfacts cover; and #552 COWORK #33: twelve-month EPS now read from the 10-K and 10-Q XBRL (fiscal year + year-to-date - prior year-to-date) where the stored quarters cannot give it
